goal: Karyawan baru tersimpan melalui wizard enam langkah.
preconditions: Login rs.admin; layar HR > Employees terbuka.

steps.action: Buka Apps, HR, Employees, klik Create employee
steps.expected: Wizard Create employee terbuka pada langkah File

steps.action: Langkah File: pilih branch, isi employee no, nama, kategori, gender, jabatan, tanggal lahir, pilih department/service center/store, lalu Next
Langkah Dependents/Contacts/Qualifications/Employment/Licences: isi isian wajib tiap langkah

goal: Pencarian karyawan menampilkan baris yang dicari.
